title: Conserved State Ownership & Typed Transfer Architecture
qualification_scope: candidate architecture design derived from source-bound PREP06 evidence; exact PREP06 state/non-state coverage, explicit owner classification, typed transfer semantics and accepted/trial transaction design
architecture_decisions: one continuation-critical physical store has one runtime owner
hydrological storage coordinates are explicit exchange state rather than hidden SWAP coupling
accepted state is immutable during a trial and trial/result state is committed atomically
physical transfers are recorded once as typed directed events with non-negative amount and explicit conserved quantity
source_species and sink_species are distinct from conserved_quantity so species transformations do not become cross-quantity mistakes
multi-product reactions use linked typed legs and a shared conservation identity
internal versus external classification is derived from control-volume scope rather than independently written process ledgers
reporting accumulators observe canonical state and transfer journals and are never physical state owners
derived views and step-local rates are not checkpoint state
crop state is explicit for whole soil-crop conservation but crop dry matter is not silently equated with elemental carbon
GHG system state remains candidate and theory-ledger blocked
macropore state remains feature-blocked until a qualified active case and complete ledger contract exist
dormant stable surface DOM/DON/DOP is not exposed as supported runtime state

lineage_note.reason: live repository inspection found existing PREP07 and PREP08 work; ARCH01 uses a separate architecture series to avoid redefining active/closed preparatory identifiers

remaining_blockers: MIGRATION_DAG requires qualified migration baseline QM before canonical STATE admission

controlled immutable B0 retention remains a separate governance gate
supplied testbank has no active macropore case
